name: Pyramid View, 2 BDR
headline: Spellbinding 2 BDR Apt. | At The Giza Pyramid's Doorstep
summary: This mind-blowing 2 bedroom apartment is a stone's throw from the Giza Pyramids and is managed by Xuru Stays - Egypt's Top Property Management Company

description.Space:
This fascinating 2 bedroom apartment is located in Giza's district (Nazlet Al Semman) which the closest to the Giza Pyramids. 

The apartment comes with an open plan fully equipped kitchen, a full bathroom, a half bathroom and a living room with a large sofa. It is made up of two separate bedrooms (one with a queen size bed and the other is a 2 single bed). 

It also features a 55 inch smart TV with Airplay and cable channels, washing machine, a Nespresso machine, kettle and a microwave. Not to mention the fabulous balcony which features a proximate, uninterrupted view of the Giza Pyramid! The apartment is great for couples & small families. 

The styling is made with a retro yet modern twist to enhance the experience of the visiting guests.


At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.

- There is 1.5 bathroom, kitchenette and two bedrooms.
- Fresh, laundered hotel-grade pure Egyptian cotton linen, along with face & body crisp clean towels are provided.
- A dining table is also available to use. 
- Wifi, and Smart TV are also available and free of charge.
- Nespresso machine.
- 2 complimentary bottles of water & 2 coffee capsules.
description.Access: This is an 2 bedroom apartment and guests can have access to all of its features.
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
A 5 min walk from the Pyramids gate entrance. 
This unit is located in a new building in an authentic very local but also very safe neighborhood. For this reason nearby streets are not all yet paved. Guests can expect it to busy (as it is all around Cairo ; ) )
There is a pharmacy, supermarket and a bazaar (gift shop) within 1 min walking distance from this building.
Street dogs are likely to bark late at night which might be inconvenient for some guests.
 
Please note that this apartment is located in a local and modest neighborhood. Guests staying should expect that the surrounding areas to the building are not of high standards. However, the studio apartment is highly well maintained and sparkling clean as shown in the photos
description.Transit:
- Airport pickup / drop off 
We provide pickup and drop off for a competitive rate.
- Tours
We provide unique tours and excursions at very competitive prices.
description.Notes:
Please note that outside visitors are not allowed. Only guests that are included in a reservation and have submitted their proof of identity will be allowed access to the property.
Please note that smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.

agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 150 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

reviews.review: This apartment has the best view in Cairo, and is perfectly equipped with everything you need for your stay. It was beyond my expectations and I really enjoyed the stay there. With a pyramid in your back-garden and a spacious clean and well decorated place (that even has a record player) how can you not have a wonderful trip!

Excellent communication the whole time, initially had a bit of difficulty finding the apartment but Xuru Stays were one call away and directed me straight to the front door. The apartment is as spectacular as the pictures, would definitely stay here again!

It was great:)
Especially nice view of pyramid
El departamento es moderno y bien equipado, tiene una buena ubicación y una vista increíble a las pirámides. Definitivamente me volvería a hospedar aquí.
فيبس البيت مريحة و جميلة و النوم بالشقة عميق … الأثاث نظيف تعامل المضيفيين رائع و فريندلي و متعاونيين الفيو عالهرم مباشرة قضيت ايام جميلة فيها ممتنة لهم جداً 💗

L’appartement est génial ! Il est très beau, spacieux, avec vue imprenable sur les pyramides ! Cependant c’est compliqué niveau communication… nous n’avions pas eu de précision sur comment accéder à notre appartement, et avons rencontré des difficultés pendant plusieurs heures … les voisins sont cependant incroyables et nous ont aidé. Réservez, mais demandez bien avant comment ça se passe ! 
Merci encore pour ce séjour incroyable à Gizeh !
Great view of Pyramids and nice little abode.
Very nice apartment with a view of pyramid of Giza

The flat was as expected, the staff was professional and very helpful.
The neighborhood wasn't the best but we had a nice experience overall.

L’appartement est beau et propre mais l’immeuble se situe dans un bidonville.
La zone est vraiment affreuse et les escaliers aussi.

Amazing view of the pyramid! We walked 15 min to the entrance of the pyramids without any issues. Please note the area is very local. I didn't see any tourists in the surrounding area.

Ubers were always able to pick me up but for some reason had trouble dropping me back off.
great view, good wifi, strange odor out of the drain pipes. Building was hard to find
Location is great for seeing the Giza pyramids. Fantastic view of a pyramid from the apartment balcony. Nice 2br layout with enough space for everyone.

We (me, my husband and our 5.5 year old daughter) really enjoyed the apartment. The flat is quite big and comes with stylish furniture and modern/clean bathrooms. You also have everything you need to cook small dishes. You can relax in the living room with a uniqe view of the world’s largest pyramid. WiFi is very stable. And – just if you miss it for whatever reason – Netflix and Prime is also available. Outside the apartment you can experience authentic Egyptian life – not everything works in a way as it might work at your home location, but it is worth the experience.
The location of the apartment is also great. In a few minutes’ walk you are at the main entrance to the pyramids; soon also to the new Grand Museum. Just around the corner you have the opportunity to buy everything you need (Carrefour supermarket, mini markets, restaurants, bakery). 
I can also recommend the transfer from/to the airport. It's fast and reliable. On our way to Cairo we had 1,5 hours delay, but Bob was still waiting for us. Bob works with Xuru and offers also other excursions. We made with him several trips: to the Nile, to the Pyramids and to Down Town. Bob’s services are just like the flat itself a 5 star recommendation. It's convenient and easy and he helps you find your way around a city of 20 million inhabitants.
Last but not least, Xuru’s management is very customer-oriented and helps immediately in case of questions or issues.
Beautiful spot, it's in the middle of the local area so it's pretty unique. The communication was very fluid and we had a pleasant experience.

Amazing flat, everything you need for a great stay, the view of the pyramid is fantastic from the balcony. The flat is new and clean, easy check in process. However the location is a bit scary, the garbage mountain is almost right in front of the entrance, a lot of dogs and cats wonder around, we use a taxi from the host all the time so it was ok, but walking there is a bit difficult. But it’s a local experience I guess.
Breath taking views makes this place amazingly worth everything!

We had a wonderful experience staying here. We used their airport transportation to ensure we reached okay, and also took two of their tours offered and really enjoyed the hospitality and knowledge of everyone. The view from the apartment was incredible, location was convenient, and we enjoyed being able to walk around the city and see some of the local food and culture.

This apartment is an oasis of calm in a unique location. The view is absolutely amazing but the building and the street below are both pretty shocking with piles of rubbish left just outside. In saying that I would stay here again, it feels safe and the apartment itself is  high quality with most modern conveniences and XuruStays stays were generally really helpful.
Beautiful space, fully equipped + very accommodating hosts! Bring drinking water though since none was included during our stay.

Everything was so nice, cleaning as well as the facilities. 
I faced a lot of problems during check in. The main door key is not working properly. Once locked it dose not opens easily. I request to please change the door for future stays
Amazing view and really nice apartment! The communication was good,  Xuru staff helped a lot.  Would definitely recommend!

I booked this based on the view, but was honestly worried that the pictures would not match my expectations. When I got inside, however, I was pleasantly surprised to see the Pyramids standing there large and in charge! Inside the Airbnb is extremely lovely with all sorts of great touches (spent an evening relaxing and listening to Duke Ellington on the provided record player) and the beds were so comfortable with plenty of pillows which I love. Communication was excellent and there were loads of toiletries that really made the whole experience a very pleasant one. And make sure you dig into the guide for some greats tips. And, finally, I loved the welcoming support that we received from the other tenants in the building.

One note to remember as you arrive, it is what is on the inside that counts. The neighborhood is typical Cairo which you will see as your visit continues, but it was worrisome upon arrival. The Airbnb itself is very clean and the neighborhood is actually quite nice.
Muy linda vista! Departamento moderno
مسكن جميل ونظيف وتسجيل دخول مرن ومميز.

The view will really blow you away!!! The apartment itself was so clean and the beds were comfortable. It’s a gorgeous place- washing machine is helpful too. I will say that if it’s your first time in Cairo, do your research to make sure the neighborhood is a good fit for you. Everything surrounding the apartment is harsh for tourists, and may not be suitable for everyone. The apartment really is stunning and hosts are great.

BEST part of our whole trip, was our tour with Bob! Bob is a generous, kind and knowledgeable and completely made us love everything we did. He’s thoughtful and went above and beyond during our tour and rides to and from the airport. He took some stunning pictures to capture the sights! As two young women traveling, we felt so safe and taken care of. Bob takes so much pride in his work and his culture and the experience he gives people. Book time with Bob, you won’t regret it!!

피라미드 전망이 직접가서 보는것보다 좋아요.
로비층 관리인가족이 매우 친절합니다.
주변에 식료품점도 친절하고 좋아요.
집안이 좀 추워요.

We had such an amazing stay with Xuru. The view of the great pyramid was absolutely magical! The place was clean and is located in a local area which we loved. We felt so safe and it was a very quick and easy walk to the pyramids.

Bob was our guide and he’s an absolute legend! We got to eat local food and he made sure all our needs were taken care of. Bonus surprise is he’s an AMAZING photographer and makes sure to get all the best photos of you! Definitely book with them and ask for Bob.

The view from this location is priceless! 
Coordinating our stay was very easy, and the Xuru team took excellent care of us from the moment of arrival to our departure. Transportation to and from the location was perfectly executed and very much appreciated; our driver even stopped on our way to the airport on the last day so we could have breakfast! I couldn't say enough nice things about our stay and the Xuru team. Thank you!!
What an amazing stay we had! Your definitely paying for the view. Bob and Ahmed did our tours, it was reasonably priced and worth every penny. I enjoyed the feel of living like a local.
Very clean and well organised.

Tolle Wohnung mit allem, was man braucht um sich wohl zu fühlen. Die Aussicht auf die Pyramide ist der Wahnsinn. 
Das Beste war allerdings der fantastische Nachmittag mit Bob bei den Pyramiden! 
Bob ist sehr hilfsbereit und freundlich. Er liebt was er tut und hat uns mit seiner Begeisterung direkt angesteckt. 
Super informative Tour mit schönen Fotospots.
Everything was amazing. The view is insane, the appartment itself is wonderful and Bob was an amazing host and guide. I recommend taking the Pyramids tour with him. Thank you soooo much!!!

Wir haben uns in der Wohnung sehr wohl gefühlt, sie ist ruhig, gute Luft, da wenig Verkehr, der Ausblick auf die Cheops-Pyramide, den darunter liegenden Golfplatz ist bei Tag und Nacht spektakulär. Wir haben einen sicheren seriösen Fahrer gehabt. Besonders hat uns auch Hosam beeindruckt, der sehr gebildet, feindsinnigen, charmant und uns in  perfektem Deutsch durch Museen und die Stadt geführt hat.

Xuru Stays in Giza was amazing!! We had a perfect view of the one of the pyramids which was true to the listings images. My partner and I had a wonderful time and our tour guide Bob was very accommodating tour guide. We would love to visit with Xuru stays again.
My second stay here. Great staff. Great view from the balcony. Definitely a different vibe outside the apartment door but it makes for a good experience.
Amazing view and great decor. Everything was clean and comfortable.

We had a wonderful stay at Xuru’s apartment! It is spacious, clean, and comfortable. The kitchen was well equipped, enough to make multiple meals. The beds and bedding were comfortable and clean. The furniture and decor are tasteful and create a homey feeling. We were also impressed with the communication of the Xuru team. They  were always responsive and even refunded us for a power outage that took place during our stay. Last but not least, the view of the Khufu pyramid from the balcony is spellbinding. 😊

We arrived late and stayed only one night but such a lovely place with a amazing pyramid view. Wish you to come back
Thank you

O apartamento é lindo, agradável, boas roupas de cama e banho. vista para a pirâmide de Giza.
único inconveniente é a localização pois fica em bairro muito sujo.
No apartamento não há panos de louça e limpeza e nem vassoura. De resto tudo perfeito.
Foram nos buscar no aeroporto na hora prevista e muito gentis.

The apartment is beautiful! Apart from the magnificent view, the whole design is amazing including a Duke Ellington LP and very special black and white photographies. We also enjoyed the special almost rural neighborhood taking care of the horses working at the pyramides.  We cooked our meals in the best equipped kitchen and only met friendly and assisting people in all the very tiny shops around. Finally, Mr Bob: He is an experienced and supportive very kind guide, but also arranged our transports with reliable and friendly drivers.  We highly recommend this dream-Appartment and most of all, book a tour with Mr Bob! In addition, all questions you have to him or the Xuru team, immediately there is a helpful answer!
Very nice stay, it was really worth it. The view was exceptional.

I wouldn’t recommend any other place to see the pyramids and the view is just the best you can get there. Since it’s located next to a gulf camp you get to see some green among a city that it’s predominantly brown, something you will really need from all the Cairo hustle. The neighborhood is very friendly overall.

The stay was just like the pictures , beautiful view of the pyramids. The Airbnb itself is very spacious surprisingly which was great. Also the team of drivers is always on time and helpful. Great stay overall that being my first time in Cairo.

This place is exactly what is advertised. Beautiful balcony with a perfect view of the pyramid! The space is peaceful and clean. Would definitely stay again and highly recommend if you plan on making a trip to see the pyramids and Cairo. They offered free transport from airport and were helpful in setting up a ride back to the airport when leaving! Xuru stays is top notch.

Daire içi fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi.Temizlik iyiydi. Sokaktan girdiginiz anda nereye geldim diye dusunebilirsiniz ama daireye girdiginiz zaman baska bir dünyada oluyorsunuz. Mahalle ile hiç bir alakasi yok. Manzara mükemmel.Piramitler balkondan çok net gözüküyor. Arada başka bir yapi yok. Tavsiye ederim.
Coming back to the Airbnb was such a treat after a hot day exploring Egypt. We had an amazing time.

For starters, the view is worth every penny and more.... apartment is absolutely beautiful and modern and super comfortable... location is perfect for local shopping and close to pyramid complex.... the hosts are amazing and Bob is the best tour guide in  Cairo. Also booked a sunset cruise on the Nile and a day trip to Alexandria.... 10 stars
Awesome apartment.  The view of the great pyramid was better than the pictures.

Beautifully updated apartment with amazing pyramid views!  The neighborhood was lively, and locals were very friendly.
our host Bob was outstanding!  Having lived in Cairo his whole life, he was extremely knowledgeable.  Bob was always super responsive and helped make arrangements for everything we wanted to see.  He picked us up from the airport and made sure to point out areas of interest and filled us in on local customs and courtesies. He served as a guide for a few different tours we took. He helped us, (myself, my husband and our 2 college students) feel very welcome and comfortable. We are very sure we would have felt very lost without his help. We could not reccomend more highly!
Beautiful place, responsive host, great view of the pyramids! I would recommend this place to anyone.

The view at this stay is amazing. You’re literally staring at the Giza Pyramid. Very beautiful and clean apartment. AC works well and very hot water. Only thing about this place is that it is surrounded by the village people who raise cattle, take care of the camels, horses. Dogs are outside in the street eating piles of trash that left out for garbage pickup. Dogs however did not seem violent and were minding there own business. We walked the neighborhood and felt very safe. I personally enjoy staying around locals but I wanted to share this so people get a true perspective of the place. Again, the apartment is like a magical oasis compared to its surroundings.

This view is so incredible it’s stunning. Definitely have to see it in person. The inside of the Airbnb is very clean, cozy, with great quality. 

The host provided a seamless transfer from the airport to the Airbnb and back. They were also responsive. 

The view alone is worth every penny. If the pyramids of Giza are on your bucket list then stay here. You will love it. 

Cons: The wifi is spotty so Be aware of that too. The surrounding area is underdeveloped and looks a bit sketchy. Uber drivers had a difficult time finding it as it’s located on a small backroad. But if you hire the hosts driver then you won’t have a problem. They are very kind and efficient. The guest bathroom near the entrance was a bit smelly. Not sure why, it was clean.. but it maintains an odor for some reason.

The apartment was in great condition and we had everything we needed, Bob(the person who picked us at the airport) made our stay a lot easier, he was very friendly, gave us a lot of recommendations , we also took his tour to the pyramids and it was great
(detailed explanations of the history of the sphinx, the pyramids and the egyptian culture).

I told them I would show up at 3:00 am and to be sure to leave the key 

They said okay that’s fine but when I showed up they didn’t leave the key and I was stranded walking through the city with nowhere to go and a nearly dead phone.  
 
I called them multiple times with no answer. Very disappointed.

Wonderful pad with an unbelievable view of the pyramid (Khufu pyramid). Modern and newly refurbished apartment with air-conditioning in all rooms and the lounge area made the stay very enjoyable. If you don't mind staying in an area with the locals then I would definitely recommend this pad plus you are able to immerse yourself in the culture and experience of Egypt. Extremely close to all the Giza pyramids and the Sphinx!!
Better than the pictures
todo excelenteeeeee

Our flight arrived in the middle of the night, so we were grateful the host provided transfer. Our driver Samir was amazing. He offered to stop and take photos and even treated us to fresh mango juice.  

Host directions to get inside the building were easy. The elevator did not work, but we do not mind stairs. I was initially surprised by how underdeveloped the surrounding neighborhood and the rest of the apartment building was, but at no point was it unsafe. Locals are very friendly.

The apartment itself is a gem. It is very clean and comfortable, with lots of amenities. The wifi is not great but the view alone is worth it!

If staying by the pyramids is your thing, this place is it. If you prefer a more modern city,  consider Cairo. My husband and I loved immersing ourselves in the culture and waking up to the pyramids, so this was perfect for us.

I recommend using the host’s transfer. Bob or his team will pick you up. We also used them for tours. They are the best guides ever!
位置离金字塔不算远，可以步行到达。周围环境不太好，但是房子干净整洁，价格合适。房东回复非常及时而且给了很多帮助，非常好。总之是高性价比的选择。

Logement décoré avec goût et fonctionnel, parfait pour une famille de 2 adultes et 2 enfants. Le wifi fonctionne très bien. La vue sur la pyramide de Kheops est imprenable, depuis le lit de la chambre parentale, du balcon et même de la table à manger. Lit baldaquin romantique dans la chambre parentale avec guirlande lumineuse. Nous avons vraiment beaucoup aimé ce logement.
An over all great experience; breathtaking location and amazing facilities.
Best view you could get. Waking up to the pyramids was a once in a lifetime experience. Fell in love with Egypt Will definetly be back to stay here!
AMAZING views! The place is really cute, has all the amenities you’ll need and is super clean. We would highly recommend this place!
El apartamento maravilloso, muy limpio y ordenado .
the place is amazing and the host is super cooperative

I would like to thank the host for the great service I've received and for being very professional and cooperative.

the place was super beautiful and I felt at home My family loved the place.

The living room view is awesome to the pyramids. 
But the building and neighborhood are kinda sloppy.
That’s great that they offered a pick-up service.
I’d say that they tried to make it the best, but the disadvantage of the apartment itself is there. 
They reply very fast.
Thanks!
Very nice place with a fantastic view of the Great Pyramid

Location to pyramid was great as well as the view. Having Bob as a personal tour guide for excursions versus joining a large group was amazing. We were on our own time versus having a rigid schedule to follow.  I would probably not have found out about ftir if it weren’t for him. Thanks Bob. 

Another added extra were usb ports throughout the home! I had my converter but it was nice to not need it.

The Pyramid view from the balcony and couch is excellent. The rooms have cozy, cute decorations. The washer, hairdryer, and Nescafe machine provided were appreciated. But there is a piercing, constant alarm ringing across the street that you can hear in all rooms at all times. The price is way too much. The area has a local, authentic charm, but there are literally piles of garbage along the street. We were not allowed to drop off our bags early or check in early, even though check out is 4 hours before check in. Food options nearby are abysmal and ordering delivery is impossible without an Egyptian phone number, which the host refused to help with. I'd avoid this place.
nous avons apprécie notre séjour dans cet appartement. Le confort et la propreté sont présents.
Very nice stay that met our expectations.

This hotel is a nightmare and the biggest mistake of my trip. NO information is correct. My trip is severely delayed because of this hotel. Book it if you want to leave your luggage unattended at arrival or carry your luggage yourself from third floor with your hands. 
首先，房间是干净整洁的，且有金字塔景观。但是我也为此付了钱，超过一百美元一晚，比附近其他酒店要显著高不少。
除此之外，旅行者应该希望得到的舒适和可靠，这家酒店完全没有。这家酒店是个噩梦，基本没有任何信息是准确的，严重影响了我们的行程，以至于我们需要去两次金字塔（买两次票），改机票提前回开罗再去第二次埃及博物馆。这家酒店是我这次最差的决定，而因为行程耽误，我也没有机会在房间欣赏什么金字塔景观。
房东主动给我提供了机场接机，我欣然接受，房东给我发消息说接机已经确认，给了我司机名字和电话，让我WhatsAp司机。因为他说接机已确认，且中国不能用WhatsAp，我以为司机电话是给我到达联系使用，结果当我早上七点到机场，没有人接机，无论是房东还是司机都没有人接电话。等了超过半小时以后我们只好放弃自己打车。
然后预定的时候我也和房东确认了可以在入住之前保管我们的行李，然而房源那里几乎就是叙利亚，也没有任何管理处的人，完全不可能把行李放在那边，房东仍然不接电话，我们从早上八点半打电话到十点才能联系到房东。我们整个行程被耽误了三个小时，以至于当天无法看完胡夫金字塔，我们第二天只能第二次买票去金字塔，又造成无法看完埃及博物馆（我们看得比较细，但如果第一天能看到胡夫金字塔，肯定能看完），只能改机票提前回开罗再去买票看，非常不方便。如果房东没有做出虚假保证，我完全可以包一天车看完景点再入住的。
然后房东提供的无线网络信息是完全不准确，他说的网络不存在，而在我反复指出来之后，他也只在第二天晚上才给我提供正确的网络和密码。
在我们退房的时候，整栋楼停电了，我们需要用人力把所有行李从三楼搬到零楼。
总之，如果是上午到埃及（也就是所有中国游客），非常不推荐这里

Amazing place with outstanding view on the Pyramid. 
It fits great for longer stay. Better than any hotel near by (in average price).
Thank you for hosting us.

Xuru Stay team was really helpful for our stay! The place is clean and got everything we needed. Lover the balcony view to Pyramid it was really close!  We were told about the condition of the local neighbourhood so things were expected as told. 

Also a shoutout to the pick up service by Bob 5 stars plus! He made things super easy and great commnunication! We ended up booking a few tours with him :)

We had an amazing stay here! The team was so helpful and responsive. They even offered a free shuttle from the airport to easily find the place. Location is very convenient for visiting the pyramids, saqqara and Memphis. The papyrus institute is two blocks away at the main avenue. 
The apartment is pretty spacious. When we arrived it was super clean and smelled good. It’s equipped with full kitchen, oven and washing machine. 
The view is beautiful and same as in the pictures.
Was really happy with the view of the pyramids and how clean the apartment was, looks just like the pictures.

Awesome views of the pyramids, better than the photos. 
Pristine apartment, beautiful design. Clean bathrooms, comfortable beds. 

The only con I can find is that the road is under repair and some taxi drivers take a while to arrive. 

The entrance to the building is a little old, I hope they improve it soon, because once inside the apartment everything is fabulous. 

Also Bob give us a tour in the pyramids, super kind and also take us the best photos of our trip. 

Great deal !

Pros:
- great view
- stylish
- 10 min walk to pyramids 
- 5 min walk to Marriott Mena House for breakfast

Cons:
- poor water pressure 
- constant beeping noise outside 
- garbage near the elevator 

Overall recommend if you don’t want to overpay for Marriott, but want the view and proximity.

Apartment with splendid view of Giza  pyramid. Knufu's pyramid is very close and can be seen from bedroom, living room and balcony. Walking distance to pyramids area entrance. In neighborhood  few restaurans, local fast food, lovely bakery and small local shops. People on the street very friendly and helpful. Safe to walk at night.  The area with very local vibe of old Giza. The apartment itself it's specious and nicely furnished. Well equipped with everthing You need for holiday stay. Fresh linnen and towels and hot water. Wi-fi works akceptable. The building staircase needs refreshing. The one thing for minus is a street garbage just in front of the building entrance, spreading on the street. Xuru's team very helpful and aleays  available. Prepared lot's of recomendation for restaurants and trips. We had very nice driver for airport pick-up and local trips. He provided us helpul information about local  culture, historic  places and took care of our safety. We higly recommend him.

The view from the house was more beautiful than the pictures and the house was nicely decorated. However, I can't say the same for the neighborhood. And we would also like to thank Bob for making our vacation in Cairo unforgettable. Bob is not only a great guide but also a wonderful photographer. He helped us a lot with everything. If you're looking for a good guide in Cairo, you should definitely get in touch with Bob.

The place is beautiful - amazing furniture, cool design, and superb balcony with great view of the pyramid right in front of you. I especially like the quick responses from Disney Bob (😜) and his great hospitality and guide. You can take the extended tours from the host - worth it! Highly recommended!

The place is just behind a Golf course so you get to see greens and the Pyramid right from the rooms. The room decors are great! All the amenities you may require are provided. It’s walkable to the Pyramids. 
You have showers only in one bathroom so that might be something to consider apart from that everything is prefect for a few days right next to the Pyramids

top of the range apartment for this area, the best view, impressive interior, lots of effort and expense has gone into making this apartment very nice. 

comfy beds, fully equipped kitchen, priceless view over the Marriott golf course towards the great pyramid. you can't get better in Giza so it was ideal for us for a few nights.

 the apartment is difficult to find and the building itself (lobby and lift) is a bit unsure, but once you are inside the apartment you won't regret it.

only issue is you can't have a warm shower because the hot water pressure is so low it won't come out the shower head. this needs looking at and easily resolved.

Eine schön eingerichtete Wohnung mit allem was man braucht und einer unglaublichen Aussicht, genau wie auf den Bildern nur noch besser.
Das Team war stets bemüht all unsere Angelegenheiten schnell zu klären trotz das wir mit all unseren wünschen sehr spontan waren und haben uns alles ermöglicht was möglich war.
Immer wieder gerne.
Danke noch einmal an das XURU Team.

Tres bel appartement avec vue magnifique sur pyramide 
Calme pour un appartement dans gizeh / Le Caire 
 la rue n’est par contre pas propre ( nous étions au courant avant ) et l immeuble ancien 
Le transporteur et le gardien de l immeuble sont très accueillants

Best view in Giza! 
People in the neighborhood are lovely! Close to the pyramids but far away from the hustle.
Tal cual las fotografías mostradas, todo bien.

Great place to stay, amazing view of the pyramids. Outside is a bit dirty buts it’s because of the area but inside the apartment is super clean. I will recommend this area people around were so friendly and host as well.
Great place to stay. Amazing view.

The apartment was very nice, clean, with an impressive view of the pyramids. The neighborhood wasn't the best in the world, but it wasn't bad, and it was very quiet. There are good restaurants nearby.

I absolutely loved my stay! I felt comfortable in the area and the views really are better than the photos. Xuru was extremely communicative and I truly appreciated the airport pickup. I did find Ubers were able to find me for other needs, and there are restaurants nearby. I shared that a bit more detail for check in would have been helpful and fyi, I figured out the hot water trick in the shower my last day but everything else was wonderful. Note the area is a little noisy but that has nothing to do with Xuru and I think is likely if you stay anywhere nearby. I truly loved my stay here and hope to be back again. Thanks for everything!!

El departamento por dentro lindo grande, pero por el precio es bastante para lo económico que es Egipto pagamos solo para estar cerca de giza. 
Las calle muy oscuras y sucias 
Pero la vista a las pirámides espectacular

The view from the apartment is fantastic, as per the photos. Incredible view over the wall to the gardens and the pyramids. Very clean and spacious unit. The building itself is sketchy. Some other units in the building are abandoned, boarded up with cracks. Women with bare hands picking through bags of garbage on the road. It's night and day.

The host offered us a free transfer from the airport. Then before we arrived try to charge us. Either way, we waited with little kids for an hour for the driver who never showed up. Really sucked after getting in so late. Don't bother with the offer, since it's only about 10 euro to get to the unit.

The view is better than the pictures. The apartment is kept in a great condition. The neighbourhood isn't exactly well off but nobody bothers you and people are helpful. Isa the watchman is extremely helpful. Only thing that could be improved upon is the condition of the lift in the building and the hot water pressure in the bathroom.

المكان جدًا جميل وبإطلالة جميلة على الأهرامات من افضل زاوية ممكنة.

لو بتسكن عند الاهرامات انصح بالسكن في هذا المكان

Top Unterkunft. 
1 A Aussicht auf die Pyramiden. Besser geht es nicht.
Unterkunft war sauber und perfekt für drei bis vier Personen.
Umgebung Giza ist nicht die Beste. Aber das weiss man hoffentlich vorher. Wir hatten keine Probleme.
Shops für Getränke und andere Sachen sind in unmittelbarer Nähe.
Grand Museum ca. 10 min mit Uber.
Area der Pyramiden ebenfalls in zehn Minuten mit dem Uber erreichbar.

Kleiner Tipp.
Ohne Auto auf dem Gelände ist doof. Es ist sehr weitläufig. 
Ein bissel mehr zahlen und einen Private Guide nehmen. Da weiss man vorher was man bezahlt und wird später nicht böse überrascht

The location is great. The apartment is renovated and nice. The Xuru Stays responds very quick. However, there's a few things that need attention. The main toilet when you flush it you have to wait about 30 minutes for the tank to fill up, we had no hot water in the shower.. until the last day I figured out myself because the so called plumber actually didn't know anything. The Shower Tub doesn't drain the water well. There's trash right by the front of the apartment that makes the whole area smell and flies all over the apartment balcony. Also, Xuru could put an apartment number on the door would be helpful. The highlight of our Trip was BOB. He's very sincere, picked us up at the airport very late at night. Very personable, informative and takes his time helping you out. He made our trip at the Pyramids very pleasant. I will recommend anyone who plans to come and see the pyramids, see Bob and they'll enjoy his services.
Merci l’équipe xuru stays. L’appartement était propre , agréable et dans endroit très calme . Moi et ma famille y avons passé un superbe moment à très bientôt

The place is in a dodgy neighbourhood with a trash dump just outside.
It is however a pretty short drive away from Marriott hotel and restaurants, pyramids and other goodies of Giza.
Staff helped us to check in: helped with our luggage and showed the way to the flat. The building has a lift.

There were problems however:
Several occurrences of brief (15-20 min) whole-building power shutdown.
No internet for the whole first day (you will have to convince the staff that you are able to connect to WiFi and it's just the WiFi itself that can't connect to the Internet, like unpaid or something).

Note that the second bedroom doesn't have windows.

The view is amazing, the staff is friendly and helpful. There were no issues in regards to the flat itself.
Nice and clean apartment with great views of the pyramid, recommend!
Wonderful view, wonderful host, and a wonderful trip, thanks!

really liked the view of the pyramid 
nice cozy and clean apartment 👌🏻👌🏻
La atención del anfitrión muy buena, respondían rápido a las consultas, la casa muy bien ubicada con una vista espectacular a una de las pirámides.

If you are looking for a beautiful apartment to stay in with a view of the Giza Pyramids, this is a great choice. The apartment is beautifully decorated with infamous photos like Louis Armstrong at the Sphinx and the iconic Egyptian singer Oum Katthum. The beds are very comfortable and waking up to the Pyramids is like a dream. The host was extremely responsive and even arranged for us to be picked up from the airport. I highly recommend this Airbnb!
We had an amazing view of the pyramids from our balcony and close access to all things around.
Terrible and digasting area, suitable apartman

Airbnb au top, face aux pyramides. Photos identiques à ce qu’ils proposent ! Très spacieux et propre. 

Une chose à redire uniquement sur le quartier qui craint un peu, et pas grand chose a côté.
Kamar yang indah, sesuai di foto, hanya saja bau sampah di depan jalan, tapi tidak masalah karena semua terbayarkan dengan keindahan kamar dan piramida view

Amazing view, very close to the entrance to the pyramids. Great hosts helpful and resourceful. If you have any concerns about going or getting somewhere they find someone that can help. Great my experience went great.

Alojarse en este flat en Guiza ha sido muy buena experiencia , casi como vivir dentro de una postal. Despertar cada mañana con las vistas impresionantes de la Gran Pirámide es algo que quedará grabado en mi memoria para siempre.
El apartamento es moderno y limpio . Cada rincón refleja buen gusto y un cuidado especial para que los huéspedes se sientan como en casa.
La atención por parte de los anfitriones ha sido maravillosa, te  recogen en el aeropuerto, buenísimo detalle!!!
Si buscas un lugar que combine comodidad, encanto y una conexión directa con la historia milenaria, este alojamiento es simplemente perfecto. ** Nota: Quiero mencionar que las calles colindantes pueden estar un poco descuidadas, algo común en la zona, pero esto no debería considerarse un punto negativo. Es algo ajeno a la propiedad. La ubicación es tranquila y, sobre todo, muy segura. Que esté en una calle secundaria alejada del bullicio de las principales, permite disfrutar de la majestuosa vista sin ruidos.
the view is splendid. as what the picture shows

Logement conforme aux photos, vue incroyable sur la pyramide de Keops. Le gardien a été très accueillant et nous a aidé à monter les valises. Le quartier et le bâtiment ne sont pas de toute fraîcheur mais il est facile de se déplacer et de trouver de quoi manger dans le quartier. Le seul problème est que les chauffages ne fonctionnaient pas, nous avons contacté les hôtes plusieurs fois, ils ont toujours été très réactifs mais n’ont cependant jamais réglé le problème. Logement confortable malgré tout.
Nice unit for pyramid view
A bit hard to find but they will provide the pick up service. Great view of the pyramid!! Specious room. Team is responsive!!

Spędziliśmy w Kairze kilka dni. Bardzo polecam to miejsce. Piękny widok za oknem i spokuj to jest to co potrzebujesz po dniu pełnym czasem nie łatwych wrażeń. Mieszkanie jest czyste,  dobrze wyposażone i jest większe niż wydaje się na zdjęciach! Polecam!

The apartment was amazing the view is breathtaking, and looks identical to the photos. The pyramid view was best way to wake up in the morning. The neighborhood is safe although it looks very crowded. looking over the golf course is very peaceful for bird watching and gives you serenity away from the chaos.

 Bob from Xuru Stays was the best tour guide we could have ever asked for. We will be recommending Bob to any American that wants to see Egypt. Bob was knowledgeable and helpful with every question we had. He arranged everything for us even for restaurant reservations and transportation. He made our days organized and we felt safe at all times. My daughter is 4 and still talks about how much she loves Bob. It was truly a special experience and we owe it all to Bob. If you want to see the best perspective of Egypt, Bob from Xuru stays is your guy. We will absolutely be returning to the Airbnb and for Bob as our tour guide. Thank you for everything Bob and Xuru stays
Thanks to Bob and Amena aspecially!

Une vue exceptionnelle depuis le salon et la chambre , un appart très grand et superbement décoré . Il était très agréable de revenir se poser dans cet apart après nos journées d excursion . Les draps de lit et serviettes de bain sentaient bon la lessive , et l hôte avait laissé des petits chauffages d appoint , ce qui était bien venue en cette saison fraîche . Nous retiendrons de ce séjour une vue à couper le souffle et un appartement parfait pour une famille avec enfant . Le wifi marchait parfaitement et la tv connecté un plus . Merci à xuru d avoir pu arranger rapidement quelques  désagrément indépendant de sa volonté .
absolutely amazing view!

muy bonito departamento. la persona muy amable y contestaba rápido. tuvimos un percance con el baño pero fue solucionado rápidamente. 
en general todo estaba perfecto.
lugar muy cercano a las pirámides.

Die Wohnung ist sehr sauber, die Aussicht auf die große Pyramide ist super. Es ist alles vorhanden, was man benötigt (Handtücher, Bettzeug, Waschmaschine...).
Schade, dass es in der Küche kein warmes Wasser zum abwaschen gibt. Es wäre gut sich selbst die Nespresso Kapseln mitzubringen, für die dort vorhandene Maschine. Wir haben in einer Woche nicht einen einzigen Supermarkt mit Nespresso Kapseln gefunden. Der Gastgeber hätte uns welche besorgt, aber das war uns zu teuer. Ansonsten ist die Wohnung und der Gastgeber super. Hausflur und Aufzug, sowie Umgebung sind ortstypisch.
Fabelhafte Aussicht!

Väldigt fint boende med fantastisk utsikt. Området är inte trevligt dock. Sopor överallt och trappuppgången är riktigt illa det med och luktar. Själva lägenheten var dock mycket bra och kommunikationen funkade väldigt bra. Att det inkluderade pickup var fantastiskt smidigt
We absolutely loved our stay and the location was brilliant. The apartment was beautiful and we loved the vintage style decor. Great amenities! Thank you!

The location is near to pyramids but the street is so popular. When you go out I suggest to you to be careful. It’s an old building but it’s seems safe because there are cameras and an available gardien.
But when you enter to the apartment the view is breathtaking you see the grand pyramid so near to you. The apartment is so clean and like a hotel quality. Recommend it. But as I said before, it’s not recommended to only girls because outside is so popular. I suggest it to a family or a couple but never girls lonely !

joli logement, spacieuxbet avec une très jolie vue !
le petit bémol pour nous, le logement était propre sauf le sol qui nécessitait vraiment de repasser la serpillière. l'hôte a fait un geste en retour par rapport à ce désagrément ce qui est appréciable.

Waking up and going to bed with the view of the Great Pyramid only for you is undeniable the strongest point of this place. Located at a very walkable distance from one of the entrances of the Giza plateau, I enjoyed the calm inside the place in contrast with the hectic atmosphere once you’re out. Had an overall great stay and would recommend to anyone coming to visit the Pyramids and tasting a bit of the flavor of Giza.

Only good thing is view of pyramid. House was dirty and full of flies. Host provides a number they do not answer which resulted in us sitting at the front in 40 degree heat for 3 hours upon arrival. 
It is located on a dirt road with a rubbish pile directly in front of the house. Much better options to choose in Cairo for the same price

Dairenin temizliği, genişliği ve manzara güzel fakat manzarayı seyretmek için balkonda oturamıyorsunuz çünkü sokak çok kötü kokuyor ve sokaktaki çöpler yakıldığı için sürekli kötü pis bir duman oluyor. Bulunduğu sokak merkezi değil bu nedenle Geç saatlerde daireden çıkış giriş insanı ürkütüyor. Daire sanırım bir kurum tarafından yönetildiğinden samimiyetten uzak, isteklerinizin neredeyse tamamına olumsuz dönüş yapılıyor. Açıkçası ben işletmecileri de beğenmedim. Ama derseniz ki ben erken girer çıkarım uberle her yere giderim camları açmam balkona çıkmam.( kaldıki sigara kullanıyorsanız mutlaka çıkmanız gerekecek çünkü daire içinde sigaraya da izin verilmiyor) oturur içerinden manzarayı seyreder. Dairede zaman geçiririm. O zaman kalınabilir bir daire

The apartment itself is beautiful—stylish, clean, and with an amazing view. Inside, everything was just as shown in the photos.

But the neighborhood was a big shock. The building is in a very run-down area, with trash and rubble on the way in, and the entrance felt unsafe. We felt nervous coming and going, even though nothing bad happened.

Great interior, but the location really affects the overall experience.

I wish I could post photos for you to see. The apartment itself was okay, I guess. But the building it’s on, and the neighborhood was so bad we kept thinking about leaving to a different hotel or something. The view of the pyramid is amazing… but you can’t even sit on the balcony to enjoy the view because of the smell of trash. RIGHT outside was a pile of maybe 50-100 pounds of trash including food and even the SKIN OF AM ANIMAL. Just imagine the smell and the flies and the bugs that brings. I felt gross the entire time. It is not well advertised. I thought a neighborhood right by the pyramids would be a nice place to stay. And I’m sure others think the same when booking. Truly the most gross, dirty place I’ve ever traveled. I can go on and on. I hate to leave a negative review as the host was communicative and kind. But I don’t want anyone to make the same mistake. I can’t say enough how dirty the area is. They don’t believe in dumpsters. So sad. It was a hard week for my family. :(
Great host! Helped us with everything, booked some great tours through them. Always answered quickly!
Es la mejor vista de todo El Cairo!!! Soñado!!!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Five stars! The Airbnb was exactly as pictured—clean, comfortable, and with a beautiful view. But what truly made my  trip unforgettable was Bob, the tour guide recommended by the host. He was always on time, incredibly kind, and went above and beyond to make sure we had the best experience possible. He guided us through every site with care, and made Egypt feel welcoming and magical. I would never visit without a guide like Bob. Highly recommend both the accommodation and Bob’s services!
Amazing place

We had a fantastic stay at Xuru Stays in Cairo! From the moment we booked, the host was incredibly responsive, any minor issue we mentioned was resolved immediately, which made everything hassle-free.

A big shoutout to Bob, who was amazing throughout our stay. He arranged both airport pickup and drop-off, which I highly recommend, it made the whole process so smooth and stress-free, especially after a long flight.

The apartment itself is gorgeous, the decor feels homely yet contemporary, with a stylish touch that made it such a comfortable place to unwind. It's also really spacious, way bigger than we expected, and the air conditioning was an absolute life saver in the Cairo heat! Everything was spotlessly clean, which we really appreciated.

We were pleasantly surprised by how friendly and welcoming the locals were. My wife and I walked around the neighbourhood past midnight and felt completely safe, the area has a very relaxed and warm vibe.

Overall, an amazing stay!!
I loved this place, just perfect
The view is very nice, but the garbage in front of the apartment and the smell are hard to miss. The apartment could also be cleaner. Apart from that, everything was ok
We had wonderful stay! Everything was good, Thank you for hospitality!
What a view! The pictures don’t do it justice, it’s truly breathtaking! The apartment is so cute and clean and the host was very sweet!

Positive:
Great views of Pyramid, that's all about this place

Negative:
Surrounding areas of the property is untidy.
neat room with perfect view

Das Appartement und die Aussicht sind wirklich sehr schön. Der Boden und die Küche waren leider bei unserer Ankunft schmutzig. Das WLAN war 
 langsam, aber Netflix hat auf dem Fernseher trotzdem funktioniert. Das Appartement befindet sich in einer sehr heruntergekommenen Viertel in dem wir uns aus einer europäischen Perspektive nicht sehr sicher gefühlt haben. Es gab auch keine andere Touristen. Wer wenig Wert auf die Umgebung legt und keine hohen Anforderungen an Sauberkeit hat, erhält ein hervorragend ausgestattetes Appartement mit traumhafter Aussicht und einem sehr erreichbaren, höflichen Gastgeber.

Erg prettig privéverblijf met fantastisch uitzicht op de pyramide, nog indrukwekkender dan op de foto. Appartement is schoon, erg comfortabel en luxe, ook voor europese begrippen. Prijs-kwaliteit is 100% goed. Xuru stays is altijd bereikbaar en biedt allerlei services aan. Aanrader!
Çok güzel düzenlenmiş ve temiz bir evde piramitlere karşı uyuyup uyanmak çok keyifliydi teşekkür ederiz

The positive is that the listing is accurate and looks like the photos. They also share a check-in video that makes finding the apartment easy (while the written instructions are less helpful). 

The negative is that the entryway in the building is dirty, dusty and has trash in it. Unlike outside I feel this is in your control. 

Outside as other guests have noted there are two large piles of trash and no bin collection. We visited in winter so no smell, however, this did attract packs of dogs and on leaving a house rule is to take the trash out which meant having to purposely litter and throw our trash on the pile too. 

There’s not much in the immediate area to do but the locals we interacted with were friendly and this is not an unsafe area. It’s also just 15min walk to the Sphynx Gate.
Nice space and view. Helpful hosts. Beds are amazing for a good rest after a hectic day. Definitely nice.

L'appartement est très propre, neuf et parfaitement équipé. La vue sur les pyramides depuis le balcon est absolument sublime, un vrai régal au quotidien !

Cependant, la rue est très sale avec beaucoup de déchets et des odeurs qui remontent même sur le balcon. L'immeuble est vétuste (ascenseur sans porte, etc.), ce qui contraste avec l'appart lui-même. Idéal pour la vue, mais attention à l'environnement extérieur.

Réponds rapidement à l’écoute et arrangeant 
Je recommande

While the general location of this apartment was absolutely fantastic and made getting around very convenient, there were some significant drawbacks regarding the immediate surroundings. The apartment itself is situated in a great area, but the exterior and street level left a lot to be desired. Right outside the building, there was a noticeable amount of trash and filth scattered around, which gave a poor first impression and was unpleasant to walk through daily. Additionally, neighborhood dogs kept barking throughout the night, making it difficult to get a good night's sleep. Overall, it has great potential due to the location, but the exterior cleanliness and nighttime noise definitely impacted our stay.
It was amazing this location and the view beats everything! Top notch apartment, we really loved it
Top

Xuru Stays fue un anfitrion amable, respondio rapido. El apartamento estaba ok, corresponde a las imagenes y lo mejor sin dudas es la vista a las piramides que se corresponde a la descripcion.

Puntos negativos de la experiencia:
- El barrio donde se encuentra el piso parece bastante precario, dejado, lleno de suciedad, hay mucho ruido que se escucha desde el alojamiento y dificulta el descanso. Parece inseguro, aunque nos han dicho que no lo es para turistas y no tuvimos ninguna situacion de ese tipo. Todo Gyza parece ser asi igualmente.
- El edificio donde se encuentra el piso esta en muy mala s condiciones, desde la entrada hasta el piso todo esta roto, sucio, muy dejado. Tanto el barrio como el edificio a primera vista sorprenden negativamente. Encontrar que el piso esta bien fue una grata sorpresa luego de eso.
- No fue posible ingresar antes de las 3PM, un check in time muy tarde para nosotros, dado que llegamos a las 8am y no hubo manera de ingresar antes

Beautifully appointed flat with amazing view of the Great Pyramid. Exactly like the photos. Bob at Xuru Stays organised convenient airport transfers. The surroundings (local back street) and the lift/stairs of the apartment block are as described in previous reviews - but not a problem if you are an adventurous hardy traveller. We were happy with our stay.

Eine sehr gute und saubere Unterkunft (mit Balkon und toller Aussicht auf die Cheops-Pyramide) in zentraler Lage. Die Gegend (Müll in der Straße) ist gewöhnungsbedürftig, dies war uns aber vorab bekannt. Unser Gastgeber war stets erreichbar und antwortete schnell.

Positive:
appartement tres proche du grand musée et des pyramides de Gizeh. tres propre, bien équipé et joliment décoré.

Negative:
le frigidaire est tombé en panne.

Ev ilanda gösterildiği gibiydi. Konforlu bir ortam yaratılmış. Mutfak her açıdan gayet yeterliydi. Balkon manzarası kusursuzdu. Bir dünya harikasının manzarasına karşı uyanmak güzel bir histi. We enjoyed our stay

Positive:
阳台正面对金字塔。每天看见，挺震撼的。屋子装修精美，家具现代化，在屋内舒服。设备齐备，能满足旅游需要。

Negative:
入住官方whatsapp反应慢。冰箱，空调，洗手间灯都有坏的。叫业主修，没反应。 需要添加厕纸，没反应。 楼下位于垃圾站，不能开阳台门，否则好多苍蝇进来。  建议屋内加灭蚊器。
Area isn’t the best but view is 100% accurate to the photos
